SELECT d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date, r.period_start_date, r.period_end_date, r.weeks_in_period, r.fully_loaded
FROM dim_date d JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar r ON r.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND r.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=11 AND d.day_of_week=7
ORDER BY 1

SELECT region, format, count(DISTINCT store_id) n_stores, count(*) versions, min(valid_from), max(valid_to)
FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT f.week_ending_date, count(*) n_rows, count(DISTINCT (f.store_key, f.product_key)) n_distinct_grain,
  count(DISTINCT cs.store_id) n_stores, count(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) n_loads, min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at),
  sum(f.closing_value) val_all_rows
FROM fact_stock_week f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE cs.region='West' AND s.store_id<900 AND f.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-01' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
 WHERE cs.region='West' AND f.week_ending_date='2026-03-08'),
a AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE etl_loaded_at='2026-03-09T01:00:00'),
b AS (SELECT * FROM w WHERE etl_loaded_at='2026-03-10T02:45:00')
SELECT count(*) pairs, sum(CASE WHEN a.closing_units=b.closing_units AND a.closing_value=b.closing_value AND a.receipts_units=b.receipts_units AND a.adjustment_units=b.adjustment_units THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) identical,
 sum(a.closing_value) a_val, sum(b.closing_value) b_val, (SELECT count(*) FROM a) na, (SELECT count(*) FROM b) nb
FROM a JOIN b ON a.store_key=b.store_key AND a.product_key=b.product_key

SELECT f.week_ending_date, s.store_id, s.store_name, p.category, count(*) n, sum(f.closing_value) v
FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE cs.region='West' AND f.week_ending_date IN (DATE '2026-03-01', DATE '2026-03-15')
  AND (p.category='ZZ Test' OR s.store_id>=900 OR f.closing_units<0)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH wk AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT week_ending_date AS week_end
  FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period=11 AND day_of_week=7
),
stock AS (
  -- one row per store_key, product_key, week (the 8 March load appears twice, identical)
  SELECT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, max(closing_value) AS closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week
  WHERE week_ending_date IN (SELECT week_end FROM wk)
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT st.week_ending_date, cp.category, SUM(st.closing_value) AS week_value
  FROM stock st
  JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = st.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs  ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = st.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND cs.region = 'West' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, category,
       ROUND(AVG(week_value), 2) AS average_stock_value_eur, count(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

WITH x AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.subcategory, p.delisted_on, p.is_current, f.week_ending_date, f.closing_units, f.closing_value
 FROM fact_stock_week f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE cs.region='West' AND f.week_ending_date IN (DATE '2026-03-01', DATE '2026-03-08'))
SELECT a.store_id, a.sku, a.product_name, a.category, a.subcategory, a.delisted_on, a.closing_units, a.closing_value
FROM x a WHERE a.week_ending_date='2026-03-01'
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM x b WHERE b.week_ending_date='2026-03-08' AND b.store_id=a.store_id AND b.sku=a.sku)
ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 50
